_note: The first domain-tree edges ARP published, on Intuition testnet 13579. A record, not a source of truth: every id below is a pure function of its label or its normalised URL, so re-deriving this file needs only those. Permanent — Intuition has no deletion.
_authorisation: Signed by the agent session using AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY on the user's explicit instruction on 2026-10-28 (« ok go on va faire un test en testnet »). ADR 0037's three conditions: the key was never read into the agent's context, the signer address was checked against AGENT_ADDRESS in .env before signing, and this file is the record. security.md scopes its automation prohibition to mainnet.
_construction: Domain atoms are PLAIN STRINGS (atom_type TextObject), not pinned Things. A pinned Thing hashes a document with three free-text fields, which is what split 53 labels across 118 atoms on mainnet — DeFi×5, Gaming×4, Security×4, and Infra's two differ only by a description and by a url that is the literal string "null" in one of them (scripts/measure/tag-object-discipline.ts, 2026-10-28). A plain string has no document to disagree about.
_normalisation: Lowercase, accents stripped, whitespace collapsed to single hyphens, applied before anything is hashed. The rule exists because `Design` and `design` are two nodes for ever on this graph, and that exact pair is already on 13579 with the typo `motion-desing` attached to one of them.
_assets: Each term was created with cost + minDeposit read off the chain at plan time: 0.002000000001 for the atom, 0.002000000002 for each triple. Passing the cost alone creates a term with ZERO positions (ADR 0053), and an edge with no position carries no path under the reading rule — so the deposit is not optional here, it is what makes the edge readable.

is a sub-domain of.why: The atom the liquid-democracy repo already publishes with on 13579, so a domain minted in either project is the same node. 42 edges there before this run, 0 on mainnet 1155.

has tag.why: 52,781 edges on 13579 and 58,064 on 1155 — the same atom on both chains. NOT hasTagForWriting(13579), which returns 0x6de69cc0… on the authority of docs/07_INTUITION_ERC8004_PARTNER_GUIDE.md:1025; that atom carries 311 edges on 13579, 0.6% of the chain's has-tag edges. hasTagForWriting has no callers, so nothing had been written the wrong way.

tool.note: Already existed as a plain string, with the same id on 1155 and 13579, and had never been used as the object of a triple.

payment.note: Same — already existed, unused. Chosen over `payments` because it was already there: minting the plural would have been the near-duplicate this whole construction exists to avoid. Singular is therefore the rule.

card-payment._ruleViolation: BREAKS THE ONE-WORD RULE, stated by the user about an hour after this was signed: a domain is one word, never hyphenated. The atom and its two edges are permanent — Intuition has no deletion. The replacement is `card`, which already exists as a plain string. Retiring this one means depositing on each edge's counter-triple, not removing it. See data/catalogue/domains.proposal.json `_ruleViolationOnChain`.

edges.triple: payment — is a sub-domain of — tool
card-payment — is a sub-domain of — payment

_verified.down: from "payment": 2 domains (payment, card-payment), 2 tools — stripe/agent-toolkit under card-payment, paypal/paypal-mcp-server under payment. One domain given, tools returned at two depths.
_verified.up: card-payment → payment → tool, a witness of 3. payment → tool, a witness of 2.
_verified.graphState: 44 `is a sub-domain of` edges on 13579 after this run, 43 carrying at least one position.

_twoDefectsTheTestFound: The reading rule's threshold was written as position_count > 1 and is position_count >= 1. `assets = cost + minDeposit` gives the creator exactly one position and `assets = cost` gives zero, so one is what separates a paid edge from an abandoned one. With > 1 the script reported ARP's own four fresh edges as carrying nothing. The figure > 1 answers a different question — whether anyone other than the publisher has backed the edge — and is worth ranking on later, not for deciding whether a path exists.

docs/18 states that tied parents leave a node unsettled; the first version of the script picked the first one the indexer returned anyway. Testnet supplied the case on the first run: `motion design`'s edges to `design` and to `UX` hold identical share counts, because both were created the same way and nobody has deposited since. A rule that silently breaks a tie is the owner rule wearing the stake rule's name, so pathToRoot now refuses.
_idDerivation: The atom id is calculateAtomId(data) on the MultiVault, NOT keccak256 of the data: keccak256(stringToHex("tool")) is 0x6563ece9… and the atom is 0xd6cc02f5…. It is still a pure function of the data, so anyone recomputes it from the label with one eth_call — but it has to be read from the contract rather than hashed locally, and declare/multivault.ts's atomDataForUri docstring claiming "keccak256 of these exact bytes is the atom id" is wrong.
